purpose: Prove quarantined legacy replay candidates can produce new signed active_training_eligible rows only after fresh verifier evidence, without mutating the legacy source.
acceptance: legacy row remains quarantined and unchanged
replay candidate selected from bucketed legacy evidence
fresh verifier artifact or run id required
new row active_training_eligible only when complete
promotion budget prevents noisy tool or duplicate cluster flooding
promotion_rules: Never mutate a legacy row into training eligibility.
Never write active_training_eligible from legacy evidence without fresh verifier evidence.
A recovered row must use source_kind=legacy_replay_recovered.
A recovered row must include recovered_from.legacy_row_hash.
Promotion attempts are budgeted by scan, tool, and duplicate cluster.
does_not_prove: Does not prove any real legacy ProgramBench row has been promoted yet; it proves the safe promotion contract and budget controls.
